content.comment_body: Hello! I'm experiencing the same issue. In the statistics section, it shows: Email sent = 0, Sending email failed = 62. I can't figure out what's wrong, as there seems to be no issue with the email service itself. What steps can I take to start receiving these emails? I've attached screenshots for reference. Thank you for your assistance! [user_name]
You need to enter the correct account credentials for your provider (such as Gmail) in order to send emails. Make sure you use the correct email address in your configuration.

The email address is set in my configuration, but I removed it from the screenshot to maintain privacy. It’s possible the issue lies within the secure settings of the Gmail account. Do you know how to resolve this? I’ve just enabled the SMS info feature from the Communication Module and received this: WARN Sending e-mail failed. Last reply from server: 0. Internal error identifier: 6. Number of attempts: 1. Thank you for your reply!

I just realized you are using gmail.com. Standard Gmail accounts do not normally authorize less secure clients. Reason: [document]. Solution: Enable 'Allow less secure apps' option in your Google account settings: [url]

Hi, I'm still not sure what the problem is. I have enabled access for less secure applications, but the issue persists and I am not receiving emails. Have you actually received email notifications? I'm not sure what else I can try. Another question: when you attach the current process image, can you view actual values for, say, 32 counters? I know a single counter value can be checked via SMS, but I need to see values for 32 counters in one SMS or email notification. IS THIS POSSIBLE? Thank you for your time.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter ongoing problems with email notifications in the Communication Module. Even with proper email credentials and adjustments to Gmail security settings, emails repeatedly fail to send and error messages appear. The main issue centers on the inability to receive important automated notifications, leading to user frustration and uncertainty about the correct configuration and possible product restrictions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to reliably send automated emails when properly set up, regardless of the email provider. They also hope to receive detailed notifications containing multiple process values, such as counters, in a single message.
